answer:
Your Habits note now has a tracker page. You can open it under the Page tab in Amber Notes. I haven't tried it on your phone.

- **Data:** I rewrote your free-text log as a table. It has one row per day and Yes/No columns for Walk, Read, Stretch and No phone in bed, plus a Note column. I kept your "too tired" and "party" comments. The old version is saved in the note's history.
- **Ticking off:** Today has a big round button for each habit. Tapping one saves straight to the table, and tapping it again unticks it.
- **Streaks:** Each habit shows its current streak and its best streak. A streak stays alive through yesterday, so it doesn't reset to zero before you've ticked today.
- **History:** Below that is a grid of the last 14 days.

Today (5 Oct) has no row yet. The first button you tap creates it.

I read your log as Mon 28 Sep through Sun 4 Oct. Tell me if I got a day wrong.
